items.title: Ahead-of-schedule and accident-free: Navy cuts ribbon on critical facility supporting shipyard modernization
items.description:
The newly established Officer in Charge of Construction Puget Sound Naval Shipyard (OICC PSNS) and Puget Sound Naval Shipyard & Intermediate Maintenance Facility (PSNS & IMF) celebrated a major milestone with a ribbon-cutting ceremony at Building 995 (B995) last month.

The project, completed ahead of schedule and with no mishaps, will help pave the way for the construction of the Navy’s proposed Multi-Mission Dry Dock by successfully relocating vital industrial operations.

items.title: Camp Lejeune community commemorates 43rd anniversary of Beirut bombing with memorial observance
items.description: The annual Beirut Memorial Observance was held at the Beirut Memorial, Lejeune Memorial Gardens today, bringing together leaders from Marine Corps Base Camp Lejeune, Marine Corps Air Station New River and the City of Jacksonville to honor the anniversary of the 1983 Beirut Bombing. The annual ceremony honors the fallen service members who served in Lebanon from 1981 to 1984 and in Grenada, especially those killed in the Beirut Bombing Oct. 23, 1983.

items.title: At CRDAMC, de-escalation starts with listening
items.description: De-escalation starts with listening, patience and understanding that everyone has a story we may not know. At CRDAMC, staff learn to recognize signs of escalating behavior, practice ways to calm difficult situations and respond safely when someone needs help. The goal is simple: prevent situations from escalating and make sure both patients and staff are treated with care and respect.

items.title: Navy Welder Turns Shore-Side Training Into Shipboard Readiness Aboard USS Minneapolis-Saint Paul
items.description: Hull Maintenance Technician 2nd Class Michael Bloise III used specialized welding skills gained during a shore assignment at Southeast Regional Maintenance Center to repair two mission-essential systems aboard USS Minneapolis-Saint Paul (LCS 21), preserving the ship’s deployment preparations and demonstrating the operational value of returning technical expertise to the fleet.

items.title: Keen Sword 27 Cyber Exercise Tests Multinational Cyber Defenses
items.description: As part of the Keen Sword 27 biennial exercise, an elite cadre of cyber warriors from Japan, the United States, Australia, Canada, and New Zealand are engaged in an exercise to defend critical infrastructure against simulated cyber intrusions. Allies and partners are working together, exchanging best practices, and learning new cyber tactics. Their efforts directly tie into the larger field training exercise taking place at locations across Japan.

items.title: B-Roll: Memorial Observance Ceremony Held in Remembrance of the 43rd Anniversary of the Beirut Bombing
items.description: U.S. service members, allies, veterans and civilians attend the 43rd Anniversary Beirut Memorial Observance Ceremony at the Lejeune Memorial Gardens in Jacksonville, North Carolina, Oct. 23, 2026. U.S. veterans, service members and families gather alongside the community each year on October 23 to remember the lives lost in the terrorist attacks at the U.S. Marine Barracks in Beirut, Lebanon and Grenada. items.title: Navy, Marine Corps demonstrate prototype air-defense decision tool at WTI
items.description: MARINE CORPS AIR STATION YUMA, Ariz. — Navy and Marine Corps teams demonstrated a prototype dashboard designed to help commanders assess regional threats and available air-defense resources during Weapons and Tactics Instructor (WTI) course 1-27.
